title: PeopleSoft Studio's HTML definition writer replays App Designer's captured saves: every replay test passes
statement: src/test/htmlWriter.test.ts rebuilds App Designer's captured saves (HRDMO, PeopleTools 8.62.09) through Studio's HTML definition writer and requires App Designer's rows and counters; every top-level test passed in the recorded run. Evidence about Studio, not PeopleSoft (rule 3); it says nothing about releases not captured. docs/HTML_SAVE.md lists the cases.

observations.observation: Run of src/test/htmlWriter.test.ts (node:test, TAP): 2 top-level tests, all passed.

testResults.name: HTML text is stored CRLF, UTF-16LE, NUL-terminated, as App Designer stored h01-h03
long HTML is cut into 32,000-byte chunks, the terminator in the last
